name: Stratholme
lore: The doomed city of Stratholme: the Scarlet Crusade holds the Crimson Gauntlet while Baron Rivendare's undead rule the Service Entrance.

name: Naxxramas
lore: The floating necropolis of Kel'Thuzad: four wings of plague, spiders, death knights and construct horrors before the Frozen Throne.
